subject.title: fix(matrix): preserve threaded replies and owner commands

question: Should Matrix explicit commands.ownerAllowFrom entries be accepted through the shared command-owner path before this PR can merge?
rationale: The PR changes which Matrix senders reach owner-only core commands, and repository policy treats auth/provider/channel authorization boundaries as maintainer-sensitive even when the bug is real.

options.title: Repair via shared owner seam
options.body: Add the Matrix config type field and route explicit Matrix owners through command.commandOwnerAllowFrom so owner and group command authorization stay distinct.

options.title: Accept Matrix-specific mapping
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the current Matrix-specific group allowlist merge if they decide the diagnostics and boundary tradeoff is acceptable.

options.title: Pause for broader owner policy
options.body: Pause this PR if the Matrix owner-command behavior needs a wider command-auth policy decision before implementation.

recommendation.title: Repair via shared owner seam
recommendation.body: Add the Matrix config type field and route explicit Matrix owners through command.commandOwnerAllowFrom so owner and group command authorization stay distinct.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Matrix thread/reply work and shared channel-ingress history make steipete the strongest routing candidate for the owner-boundary choice.
